notablePrerequisites: You control another Human or Solider.
description:
Cast Reins of the Vinesteed by paying {3}{G}, enchanting any Human or Soldier you control besides Siona.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature enchanted by Reins of the Vinesteed, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Reins of the Vinesteed, returning Reins of the Vinesteed to the battlefield enchanting the Human Soldier token.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
